subject: RE: Craft Brew Monthly — Bates feature
body: Hi Megan — happy to help with the feature. I am glad to talk about our beers, the brewing process, and the GABF entry, but I do not share gross revenue, yield ratios, or quarter-by-quarter sales figures. Let me know what else I can give you on the brewing side. — Larry
